author: New China TV
description:
During his U.S. visit, Chinese President Xi Jinping described the Mid-Autumn Festival as "a festival of reunion" in Chinese tradition.
In English, reunion means coming together again.
In Chinese, we say 团圆 (tuán yuán) - giving that togetherness a shape.
So, why is reunion "round" in Chinese?
#DearWord #ChineseCulture #MidAutumnFestival
title: Dear Word | Why is "REUNION" round in Chinese?

description:
Robert Pelik, a British teacher who has lived in China for six years, shares his feelings about the Mid-Autumn Festival in China. Beneath the same moon, people across mountains and seas share the same longing -- a reminder that no distance can keep us apart. 🌕
#MidAutumnFestival #MoonFestival #ChineseCulture #FestivalOfReunion #TrendyChina
title: Trendy China | Hearts connected under one full moon

Join Xinhua for a taste of Shanxi's unique take on a Mid-Autumn classic! (recorded) #MidAutumnFestival #Mooncakes #Vinegar #Shanxi #China

author: New China TV
description:
More than a quarter-century ago, American teacher Ronald Sakolsky helped support a Chinese woman's efforts to plant trees in the sands of north China.
When he returned this year, he found the once-barren landscape transformed into a forest -- and a friendship that endured across the Pacific.
Their story shows how bonds between ordinary Chinese and Americans can take root and grow.
title: From sand to forest, a friendship grows across the Pacific

author: New China TV
description:
The 48th WorldSkills Competition opened in Shanghai on September 22, with 1,385 competitors from 68 countries and regions vying in 64 skill events.
Held every two years, the WorldSkills Competition is widely regarded as the world's leading vocational skills competition.
This time, our reporter is taking us on a quick tour of the venue. Let's see what's happening!
title: Skills take center stage at WorldSkills Shanghai 2026

author: New China TV
description: At the ongoing 48th WorldSkills Competition in Shanghai, more than 1,300 young competitors from 68 countries and regions are putting their skills to the test across 64 events - in a competition that is itself evolving with AI. From cooking and craftsmanship to robotics and emerging technologies, meet the young competitors who see AI not as a replacement, but as a teammate.
title: Inside WorldSkills Competition: skills in the age of AI
